==Description==
'''Bunny Charm''' is an exclusive charm introduced in the [[Ducky Revenge Event]] as a reward for reaching Level 34 on the premium track. It had a cost of {{DuckyEggs|1,190}} or {{Robux|98}} ({{Robux|83}} during the Memorial Day 2025 Sale) to unlock it, with a total cost of {{DuckyEggs|19,030}} or {{Robux|2,810}} ({{Robux|2,372}} during the Memorial Day 2025 Sale).

==Appearance==
'''Bunny Charm''' appearance is based on the [[Nerd Ducky|Nerd Duck's Bunny Mech]]. It has the mech pointing its right arm at something. It plays a sound of a totem falling down with a duck quack in the background.

The color changes based on the player's username color, but appears orange in inventory preview.

==Update History==
*'''16 April 2025''' - [[v1.61.0]]
**'''Bunny Charm''' added.
**{{Bug}} '''Bunny Charm''' shakes uncontrollably and can collide with players.
*'''23 April 2025''' - [[v1.62.0]]
**{{Bugfix}} '''Bunny Charm''' can no longer be collided with.
*'''11 June 2025''' - [[v1.66.0|v1.66.1a]]
**'''Bunny Charm''' is no longer obtainable.
